verdict.rationale: Probes show no llms.txt (404) and no markdown docs endpoint (404), so the story's primary path fails. However, YYLO publishes versioned Skills, reusable procedures for operating YYLO and Ledger that are designed to steer an agent and install via an open-standard path, which partially serves as agent-oriented documentation. Missing for 10: an llms.txt file, machine-readable markdown docs, and independent corroboration that agents can consume the Skills as documentation.
